abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
...Kill the Big Eads: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy HEROES or MONSTERS.
...Get There Before Me!: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
...Grab That!: Add 5 to each target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: EXCITABLE FOLLOWERS
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: IMMORTAL EGO
abilities.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

abilities.name: FURIOUS ENDINGS
abilities.effect: Each time a MANIFESTATION within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 rage dice.

abilities.name: ETERNAL THRALL
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
If this unit is a Necromancer, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
If this unit is a VAMPIRE, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
If this unit is DEATHRATTLE, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: PUNISHMENT FITS THE CRIME
abilities.effect: You believe the ‘Accusations of Regicide’ DELUSION (see Grand Justice Gormayne’s warscroll).

abilities.name: ELITE GUARDIANS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

abilities.name: ROYAL BODYGUARD
abilities.effect: While any friendly non-MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those HEROES have WARD (5+).

warscrolls.name: Royal Decapitator
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

abilities.name: EXECUTIONER’S ENTOURAGE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: OFF WITH THEIR HEAD!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Immediately after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, pick an enemy INFANTRY HERO in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Grand Justice Gormayne
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

abilities.name: ACCUSATIONS OF REGICIDE
abilities.effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SERFS and KNIGHTS units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES that had any damage points allocated to them in the same turn.

abilities.name: ARREST THOSE MISCREANTS!
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has STRIKE-LAST while it is in combat with any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES and any friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS units.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

abilities.name: SKELETAL SPLINTERING
abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same WIZARD more than once per phase. Pick the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: UNHOLY SACRAMENTS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making banishment rolls for the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: DISCHARGE ARMOUR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: EBON-WROUGHT ARMOUR
abilities.effect: This unit has WARD (3+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

abilities.name: HARBINGERS OF DEATH
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscrolls.name: Arkhan the Black, Mortarch of Sacrament

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Razarak’s Ebon Claws is 3.

abilities.name: THE DOOM OF TRAITORS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST. On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Razarak’s Ebon Claws for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit.
Designer’s Note: If the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST, this ability cannot fail; however, you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.

abilities.name: CURSE OF YEARS
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Roll 10 dice. For each 6:
Give the target 1 necrotic withering point.
Roll an extra dice.
For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points, Then, do the same for each 4+ and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 necrotic withering point (do not roll any extra dice).
After a roll, if the target has 8 or more necrotic withering points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of necrotic withering points it has. Then, those necrotic withering points are lost.

abilities.name: THE STAFF OF SPIRITS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, Heal (1) this unit after that SPELL ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: MORTARCH OF SACRAMENT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that SPELL ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 18" of this unit

abilities.name: TIDE OF BONES AND BLADES
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly DEATHRATTLE units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

abilities.name: ANCIENT BURIAL SITES
abilities.effect:
If there is a friendly Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.
Designer’s Note: The original Cursed Sepulchre is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.

abilities.name: ENDLESS LEGIONS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use CHARGE abilities this turn.

abilities.name: THE RISING DEAD
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the grave.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE HUNGER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly VAMPIRE unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a FIGHT ability.

abilities.name: THE UNQUIET DEAD
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the grave. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.

abilities.name: DEATHLY INVOCATION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS units wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Codewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
Seek New Prospects: Add 5 to the target’s control score.
Don’t Argue with the Wind: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
There’s No Trading With Some People: The target can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: GRIEVOUS HALITOSIS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FORTRESS WREKKA
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You delcared the ‘Rip It Up and Chuck It’ ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown
abilities.effect: After picking the target for that ability, roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the unit in this Regiment of Renown’s Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You delcared the ‘Rip It Up and Chuck It’ ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown

warscrolls.name: Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Fortcrusha Flail is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: PRIMAL RECKONING
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Fortcrusha Flail: Crushing Blow for each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit that has been destroyed this battle, to a maximum of 10.

abilities.name: FORTCRUSHA FLAIL
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilities.name: RIP IT UP AND CHUCK IT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not uprooted, then pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
If the target is another BIG unit, excluding Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants, it is armed with a Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit’s warscroll. Modifiers to this unit’s ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the target).
If the target is a Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant or a LITTLE unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
That terrain feature is uprooted for the rest of the battle. If it is FACTION TERRAIN, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the rampage roll.

abilities.name: OMINOUS FOG
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while they are wholly within 9" of the Treelord in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: ENDLESS WANDERING
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: SHADOWCREEP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Sweeping Blows is 3.

abilities.name: STRANGLING GRASP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: LASH AND TANGLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s Strangleroots to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is within the creeping overgrowth. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS

abilities.name: THE CRIMSON KEEP

abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the Crimson Keep. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the Crimson Keep than there are on the battlefield.

abilities.name: BLOOD RAMPAGE

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER that is in combat and has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: FROM A QUARTER UNSEEN

abilities.declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is in the Crimson Keep to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.

abilities.name: CHALICE OF THE BLOOD DRAGON

abilities.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the exit point equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players lose.
Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the exit point. If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.

5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6

7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE HORNS HIT HOME
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is preparing a flank attack to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WE’LL BE THERE - IF THE PAY’S RIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve preparing a flank attack. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: RAVENOUS COUNTER-ATTACK
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: SHOCK AND GORE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

abilities.name: GLUTTHORN STAMPEDE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is INFANTRY. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilities.name: PITILESS WARLORD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: THE DECREE OF NAGASH
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly Vokmortian in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, each time your opponent declares a FIGHT ability for the target, unless they spend 1 command point as a reaction, that FIGHT ability has no effect.
Designer’s Note: That FIGHT ability does not count as a command.

abilities.name: IMMORTAL BULWARK
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: VOICE OF NAGASH
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-CORE abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MORTAL CONTRACT
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a CORE ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that CORE ability.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE LEGION
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range

abilities.name: THE NEVER-DEAD
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: ENEMY OF THE THRONE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown for attacks that target a SENTENCED unit.

abilities.name: ETHEREAL
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

warscrolls.name: Scriptor Mortis
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Cursed Soul.

abilities.name: JUDGE, JURY AND EXECUTIONER
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit uses a FIGHT ability, if all of its attacks target the same SENTENCED enemy unit, that friendly unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for that FIGHT ability.

abilities.name: SENTENCED TO ETERNAL TORMENT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the SENTENCED keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BLACK-HEARTED LACKEYS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the ’Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SUMMON HORRORGHAST
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Horrorghast wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSCREAM BRIDGE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON LAUCHON THE SOULSEEKER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SHARDS OF VALAGHARR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: THE INCARNADINE KILLERS
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: SUMMON AETHERVOID PENDULUM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulum on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON QUICKSILVER SWORDS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON CHRONOMANTIC COGS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

abilities.name: SUMMON HAND OF NAGASH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Hand of Nagash on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Hand of Nagash wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SANGUINE SWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Sanguine Swarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Sanguine Swarm wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON UNHOLY RELIQUARY
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Unholy Reliquary wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WASTE AWAY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

abilities.name: PRISON OF GRIEF
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: VILE TRANSFERENCE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, Heal (D3) the caster.

abilities.name: HARVESTERS OF SORROW
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: INSUBSTANTIAL
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: GHOSTLY PATHS
abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same WIZARD more than once per phase. Pick the Lady Olynder in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is wholly within 12" of them, that is not in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: COLLAPSING PASS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick each objective to be the targets. Then, pick 1 of the targets to be the focus.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. Add 1 to the roll for each unit (friendly and enemy) that is contesting it. If the target is the focus, you can add 3 to or subtract 3 from the roll. On a 8+, remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: COLLECT THE TITHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the GOTHIZZAR HARVESTER in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick a NON-HERO INFANTRY unit (friendly or enemy) within its combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain, then give the unit using this ability 1 bone-tithe point.

abilities.name: SOUL TAX
abilities.declare:
Pick the Mortisan Ossifector in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then:
Pick a friendly unit, excluding units in this Regiment of Renown, to be the target.
Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the recipient.
The target and the recipient must be wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
The target has a maximum control score of 1.
Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the recipient’s combat attacks.

abilities.name: REBUILD ON THE MARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Gothizzar Harvester in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it has 6 bone-tithe points. Then, pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Reset the Gothizzar Harvester’s bone-tithe points to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the Gothizzar Harvester and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE LEGION
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range

abilities.name: BONE CAGE
abilities.effect: This unit is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.

abilities.name: BONE HARVEST
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a FIGHT ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is full.

abilities.name: REPAIR CONSTRUCT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

warscrolls.name: Mortisan Ossifector
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

abilities.name: REFINED CREATIONS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai or Morghast Harbingers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
